method: Seven fresh processes per variant. Effect -> Dumling -> Dumrel -> Dumdict/runtime -> Dumgen -> segmentation -> grammar -> Reading -> empty Knowledge request, then 20 warm calls each and a malformed Lemma to exercise exact-error fallback. Deterministic injected model responses; no network. Peak deltas are paired within each process. GC occurs after all measurements.
limitations: Counterfactual Zod runtime experiment, not eligible under the current schema-free operational policy. Both Zod variants replace Dumgen's compiled registry with canonical Zod schemas; shared-schemas also rebuilds Dumrel/schema with external Dumling schema imports to avoid bundling duplicate copies. Other batteries keep their compiled runtime APIs. Only representative workflow assertions run here, not the full DX gate. Catalog, prompts, and model-output JSON Schemas are unchanged. Not deployed Convex memory.
